hero.headline: Stairs, decks and verandah carpentry in Ipswich, built to last.
hero.subhead: Timber stairs, balustrades, decks, verandahs and repairs around the house, for homes within 50 km of Ipswich. Tell us about the job and get a clear quote.

skyeGreeting: G'day, I'm the Jason Beduhn Carpentry assistant. Stairs, a deck, balustrades or a few jobs around the house? Tell me what you need and I'll help you get a quote or book a time.

about.headline: Carpentry around the house, done properly.
about.body: Most jobs start with something that's worn out: stairs gone soft, a deck that's had its day, a balustrade that wobbles, or a door that won't shut. Jason and his team fix it properly, rebuild it better than it was, and leave the place clean.

cards.title: Tired stairs & balustrades
cards.body: Front stairs, timber steps, handrails and balustrades replaced or repaired.

cards.title: Decks that have had their day
cards.body: Deck rebuilds and pool decks, built to a better standard than before.

cards.title: Odd jobs on the list
cards.body: Doors, skirting boards, fascia, verandah columns and the bits you've been putting off.

about.closing: Not sure what the job needs? Send a photo and we'll talk it through.

problems.headline: Finding a carpenter who turns up in Ipswich shouldn't be this hard.

points.title: Unreturned calls & slow quotes
points.body: You ring around for a quote and half of them never call back.

points.title: Vague pricing & surprise costs
points.body: A rough number on the day, then extras once the old timber comes off.

points.title: No-shows & missed timelines
points.body: You take the morning off and nobody turns up. The deck stays half done.

points.title: Messy job sites
points.body: Offcuts, nails and sawdust left in the yard after they've gone.

problems.bridge: You shouldn't have to chase a tradie just to get your stairs fixed.

solutions.headline: Timber work around the house, done right the first time.

services.title: Stairs, balustrades & handrails
services.body: Front stairs and timber steps replaced, balustrades and handrails repaired or rebuilt, and balcony columns swapped out.

services.title: Decks & pool decks
services.body: Deck rebuilds, new decks and pool decks and gates, built solid and finished properly.

services.title: Verandahs, patios & repairs
services.body: Verandahs, patios and outdoor shelters, plus doors, skirting boards, fascia and general carpentry repairs.

process.headline: We look at the job. Quote it straight. Build it right.

steps.title: Ask for a quote
steps.body: Send a few details and a photo with the form, or give Jason a ring. Your suburb and a rough idea of the job is plenty.

steps.title: Quick site visit
steps.body: Jason comes out, has a proper look, and gives you a clear quote.

steps.title: Booked in & on time
steps.body: Once you're happy, you're booked in. We turn up when we say and tell you if anything needs to change.

steps.title: Clean finish
steps.body: The job's done in the time frame we gave you and the site's cleaned up before we leave.

why.headline: No rushing. Just carpentry done properly.

themes.title: Turns up on time
themes.body: Punctuality is the thing our Google reviewers mention most.

themes.title: Quick quotes
themes.body: Fast site visits and a clear price, so you can plan around it.

themes.title: Built better than before
themes.body: Repairs and rebuilds done to a higher standard than what was there.

themes.title: Leaves it clean
themes.body: Offcuts and mess cleaned up before we go.

realReviews.author: T S
realReviews.text: Jason recently completed a deck rebuild for me and did a great job. Jason was always professional and respectful towards myself and my young family and he was more than happy to answer any questions I had along the way. The deck was rebuilt to a much greater standard than it was previously which is a credit to Jason and his team.

realReviews.author: Paul Attenborough
realReviews.text: We had our front stairs replaced.  Jason and his team delivered exceptional quality and were very professional.  He exceeded my expectations.  It is rare these days to have a tradesman turn up on time if at all but Jason is very reliable.  I highly recommend and we will be using Jason again for any other work we may require in the future.

realReviews.author: Pierre Bonavia
realReviews.text: We had such a great experience from Jason. His customer service and workmanship was fantastic. He responded quickly for a quote request with a fast site visit. He supplied the quote and fit in the work just as quickly. On top of that he finished the work in the advised time frame and provided a high quality finished product. Thank you Jason. We will keep you in mind for future work we have that needs to be done.

finalCta.headline: Ready to get that job sorted?
finalCta.body: Send a few details or pick a time that suits. You'll get a clear quote before anything's booked in.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a straight chat about the job.

faq.a: Send the job through the form, with a photo if you've got one, or give Jason a ring. He'll come out for a quick look and give you a clear quote.
Ipswich and suburbs within about 50 km. Not sure if you're in range? Ask anyway.

faq.q: Can you repair my stairs or do they need replacing?
faq.a: Sometimes a few treads or a handrail is all it needs. Jason will tell you straight whether it's a repair or a rebuild.
Ask when you request your quote and we'll send the licence and insurance details for your job.

faq.q: Do you take on small jobs?
faq.a: Yes. Doors, skirting boards, fascia repairs and the odd jobs on your list. Ask about bundling a few together.
